difficulty_reason: Hypothesis-verification proof: the colim-global-sections criterion of Cohomology on Sites is applied to the site X_tau with the full subcategory of objects lying over affine schemes, and each of the four conditions is verified in turn using quasi-compactness (surjective smooth cover by an affine), fppf/etale coverings refined by finite affine coverings, quasi-separatedness (the fibre product algebraic space is quasi-compact, covered by an affine), and affine equalizers.
